description: Prepare a CLI or codebase to run with the right credentials. Give it a tool name (e.g. 'wrangler') and optionally which set to use. It works out which service the tool authenticates with, checks which of this project's used sets already provide it, prompts the user to add it if missing, and tells you the exact hush_run call to make. Use this when the user says something like 'set up wrangler with my personal Cloudflare set'.

set.description: Which set to check, e.g. 'work-fal'. Default: whichever of this project's used sets already provide it.

tool.description: The command that needs credentials, e.g. 'wrangler'.

name: hush_provision
